mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety that depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1% in the prior month indicate a broad-based collapse in consumer and housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline >1% in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by >1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 (index 2017=100) and the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day forward returns due to escalating recession fears and reduced corporate earnings outlook.
regime_hint: recessionary industrial slowdown with high unemployment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average indicates weakening consumer spending, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% from the prior month signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by >0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of rising unemployment (UNRATE increasing for two consecutive months) and declining non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS declining for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative 60-day forward returns due to worsening labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases for 2 consecutive months and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
regime_hint: deteriorating labor market with job losses
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE increases for 2 consecutive months and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months.
